newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The two globally acknowledged cargo hubs for Russia and the Commonwealth of Independent States -- the United Arab Emirates and Finland -- are formalising relations in a bid to retain their leadership in supplying the vast market of the former Soviet Union.
- Emirates Airlines offices abroad to issue UAE entry visas.
- Gulf Organisation for Industrial Consulting has advised Gulf Cooperation Council states to exercise caution while considering easing of industrial licensing requirements.
